local function round(num: number, decimals: number): number
    local m = 10 ^ decimals
    if num >= 0 then
        return math.floor(num * m + 0.5) / m
    else
        return math.ceil(num * m - 0.5) / m
    end
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    if input.initial_value == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be 0" }
    end

    local raw = ((input.current_value - input.initial_value) / input.initial_value) * 100
    local pct = round(raw, 2)

    local dir: string
    if pct > 0 then
        dir = "up"
    elseif pct < 0 then
        dir = "down"
    else
        dir = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = pct, direction = dir }
end

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local list_res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if not list_res.ok then

    end

    local customers: { CustomerRef } = list_res.customers
    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local sent_count: number = 0
    local max_sends: number = 10

    for i, cust in ipairs(customers) do
        if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            if sent_count < max_sends then
                local text = string.format("Hi %s, we miss you!", cust.name)
                local send_res = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
                if not send_res.ok then
                    table.insert(failed, cust.id)
                else
                    table.insert(notified, cust.id)
                end
                sent_count += 1
            end
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end

artifact.name: compute_percentage_change
artifact.content:
function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    local initial: number = input.initial_value
    local current: number = input.current_value

    if initial == 0 then
        return { error = "invalid_initial_value", message = "initial_value must not be zero" }
    end

    local function round_to(n: number, places: number): number
        local mult = 10 ^ places
        if n >= 0 then
            return math.floor(n * mult + 0.5) / mult
        else
            return -math.floor((-n) * mult + 0.5) / mult
        end
    end

    local raw_change: number = ((current - initial) / initial) * 100
    local pct: number = round_to(raw_change, 2)

    local direction: string
    if current > initial then
        direction = "up"
    elseif current < initial then
        direction = "down"
    else
        direction = "flat"
    end

    return { percentage_change = pct, direction = direction }
end
artifact.description: Compute percent change from an initial value to a current value, rounded to 2 decimals, with direction.
artifact.usage_description: Use this when you need a signed percent change and a simple up/down/flat direction for two numeric values.

function run(input: Input, context: Context): Output
    -- List customers in the requested segment
    local res = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
    if res.ok == false then
        return { error = res.error, message = res.message }
    end

    local customers: { CustomerRef } = res.customers
    -- deterministic ordering by id
    table.sort(customers, function(a: CustomerRef, b: CustomerRef) return a.id < b.id end)

    local notified: { string } = {}
    local failed: { string } = {}
    local send_calls: number = 0

    for _, cust in customers do
        if cust.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
            if send_calls >= 10 then
                break
            end
            local text = "Hi " .. cust.name .. ", we miss you!"
            local s = tools.message.send({ user = cust.id, text = text })
            send_calls += 1
            if s.ok then
                table.insert(notified, cust.id)
            else
                table.insert(failed, cust.id)
            end
        end
    end

    return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }
end
